description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git branch behaviors, particularly focusing on interpreting exotic branch name arguments such as @{-1}, @{upstream}, etc. It includes setup procedures, test cases for branch operations, and validation of expected behaviors in various edge cases.

methods.name: expect_branch
methods.description: Checks if a branch points to the expected latest commit message.

methods.name: expect_deleted
methods.description: Verifies that a branch or reference has been successfully deleted.
